newsitem.title: USA: NYH spot distillate diffs move up by NYMEX close.
newsitem.headline: NYH spot distillate diffs move up by NYMEX close.

text.p: New York Harbor (NYH) distillate differentials firmed by the NYMEX close Thursday as sellers took advantage of colder temperatures in the Northeast to lift offers.

Prompt NYH No. 2 oil was firmed early in the day as Sun Co boosted its offer - often seen as a market indicator - to even with the NYMEX. The Philadelphia-based refiner and marketer is one of the biggest sellers of No. 2 in the region.
But the strength continued and market watchers said offers retreated to about 0.10 cent above the print, up about 0.35 cent on the day.
NYH low sulphur diesel barrels also firmed, with traders talking prompt barrels on either side of 2.00 cents.

U.S. Gulf (USG) distillate diffs eased slightly by the NYMEX close, with low sulphur diesel for the back 8th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline offered at 0.30 cent over the screen, down about 0.50 cent from Wednesday.

USG 54-grade jet fuel diffs also weakened modestly after two days of gains on solid refinery interest. Back 8th cycle barrels, which hit their scheduling deadline, at the end of the day, were talked near 2.80 cents over the print.
